text:
maia: quick heads-up: we're updating the default canary behavior for next deploy window (Mon 06:00 UTC). initial canary moves from 10% -> 20% for routes that pass the stable-fallback checklist. aim: catch perf regressions sooner.

toni: can we limit to routes with autoscaling enabled? past canaries saturated backends.

maia: yes. autoscaling required + automatic rollback if error_rate > 0.5% over 5m. fallback model must be configured.

raj: will critical customer routes be excluded?

maia: routes labeled "critical-sla" are excluded by default. owners can opt into dedicated_fallback: true to route traffic to dedicated pools when triggered.

sasha: ops note: shifting quiet window to reduce midweek churn. proposed temporary window: Sat 18:00 -> Mon 06:00 UTC for next two cycles. emergency rollouts still allowed with approvals.

toni: reminder for exceptions: open a ticket in #release-exceptions and tag @toni + @sre. include risk, rollback plan, and load projections.

deploy-bot: :loud_sound: Scheduled rollout: canary-behavior-update/v2024.11 -> Mon 06:00 UTC. owners: maia, toni. link: https://console.redwood.example/releases/2024.11

maia: doc snippet we'll publish tonight:

```
rollout:
  initial_canary: 0.2
  autoscale_required: true
  monitor:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.005
    evaluation_window_seconds: 300
  fallback_model: compatible-1.3
  exclude_labels: ["critical-sla"]
```

raj: i'll run a perf sweep on dedicated pools pre-rollout. ping me to hold if needed.

sasha: tagging release owners: DM maia by EOD if you need exclusion. :thumbsup:
